text: Cycling is an excellent low-impact exercise that boosts cardiovascular health and strengthens muscles. It is a fun activity that you can enjoy both recreationally and competitively. One of the most important components of a cycling setup is the tires. High-quality tires ensure a smooth ride, while low-pressure tires provide better grip on wet or dry surfaces. Brakes are equally important, but they typically come later in the bike. Proper tire selection and brake adjustment are essential to ensure safe and efficient cycling.
